Thank you for using the PhotoPort template. This guide will walk you through how to customize the template, update content, and publish your website.
PhotoPort was designed to be flexible and easy to edit while keeping a strong visual style. You can customize almost everything directly in Framer without writing any code.
After duplicating the template into your Framer workspace, you can begin editing the website immediately.
• Click on text to change it
• Click on images to replace them
• Update links and navigation as needed
All styles such as colors, fonts, and spacing can be modified from the left sidebar inassets panel in Framer.
All text in the template can be edited directly on the canvas.
Replace it with your own content.
Some sections may use reusable components, meaning the same text may appear across multiple pages. Editing the main component will update it everywhere.
Images are a major part of this template.
To replace images:  Select the image layer.  Click “Replace Image”.  Upload your own image.
• Maintain similar aspect ratios to avoid layout shifts
This template includes CMS collections for managing content easily.
Open the CMS panel in Framer.
Select the collection (for example Blog or Articles).
Add a new item or edit an existing one.
Fill in the fields such as title, image, description, and content.
Once published, new CMS items will automatically appear on the website using the existing design layout.
You can easily change the visual style of the template.
To maintain visual consistency, try to update styles globally through the assets panel in left bar rather than editing each element individually.
The template is fully responsive and optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
When editing content, always check different breakpoints to ensure layouts still look good on smaller screens.
You can switch breakpoints using the device controls in the Framer toolbar.
Once you finish customizing the template:
Some headings in this template use Fit Text to automatically scale based on the container width.  This allows headings to expand and fill the layout for a strong visual style.
• Very long titles may scale smaller
• For best results keep titles concise
If you prefer a fixed size heading, you can disable Fit Text in the typography settings.
The template includes a contact form for receiving messages from visitors.
Connect it to your preferred form service or email integration.
Update the contact email if needed.
Test the form before publishing your website.

You can also update links in buttons and call-to-action sections.

Thank you for using the PhotoPort template. This guide will walk you through how to customize the template, update content, and publish your website.
PhotoPort was designed to be flexible and easy to edit while keeping a strong visual style. You can customize almost everything directly in Framer without writing any code.
After duplicating the template into your Framer workspace, you can begin editing the website immediately.
• Click on text to change it
• Click on images to replace them
• Update links and navigation as needed
All styles such as colors, fonts, and spacing can be modified from the left sidebar inassets panel in Framer.
All text in the template can be edited directly on the canvas.
Replace it with your own content.
Some sections may use reusable components, meaning the same text may appear across multiple pages. Editing the main component will update it everywhere.
Images are a major part of this template.
To replace images:  Select the image layer.  Click “Replace Image”.  Upload your own image.
• Maintain similar aspect ratios to avoid layout shifts
This template includes CMS collections for managing content easily.
Open the CMS panel in Framer.
Select the collection (for example Blog or Articles).
Add a new item or edit an existing one.
Fill in the fields such as title, image, description, and content.
Once published, new CMS items will automatically appear on the website using the existing design layout.
You can easily change the visual style of the template.
To maintain visual consistency, try to update styles globally through the assets panel in left bar rather than editing each element individually.
The template is fully responsive and optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
When editing content, always check different breakpoints to ensure layouts still look good on smaller screens.
You can switch breakpoints using the device controls in the Framer toolbar.
Once you finish customizing the template:
Some headings in this template use Fit Text to automatically scale based on the container width.  This allows headings to expand and fill the layout for a strong visual style.
• Very long titles may scale smaller
• For best results keep titles concise
If you prefer a fixed size heading, you can disable Fit Text in the typography settings.
The template includes a contact form for receiving messages from visitors.
Connect it to your preferred form service or email integration.
Update the contact email if needed.
Test the form before publishing your website.

You can also update links in buttons and call-to-action sections.
